verdict.rationale: The evidence documents bank reconciliation that "streamline[s] the reconciliation process for swift month-end closing", accountant access, and general workflow triggers. Nothing describes a month-end close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs. Those features are adjacent to the story, and the MCP testimonial about month-end closures describes a user-side Claude integration, not a product checklist.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
